basic_details.job_title: DHFWS Rampurhat Multi Rehabilitation Worker Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: District Health & Family Welfare Samiti, Rampurhat Health District (Office of the Chief Medical Officer of Health & Member-Secretary), Health & Family Welfare Department (DHFWS Rampurhat), West Bengal, has invited applications for 6 posts of Multi Rehabilitation Worker under Advt No. 04/2026-2027. The online application is open from 13 November 2026 to 26 November 2026.

application_fee.details: Payment mode: Online only through net banking / UPI payment or credit/debit card, using application ID and Date of Birth after registration. Last date to pay the fee: 23 November 2026.

qualification.education_qualification: Bachelor degree in Physiotherapy with at least 2 years of working experience in a hospital; Master degree in Physiotherapy desirable
qualification.details: Qualification: Bachelor degree in Physiotherapy with at least 2 years of working experience in a hospital Experience: At least 2 years of working experience in a hospital Age limit: 21 to 40 years (as on 1 January 2026) Age relaxation: Reserved candidates As per govt. norms | Other conditions: | Desirable: | Master degree in Physiotherapy

exam_pattern.details: Marks in the score-sheet are rounded off up to 2 decimal points

how_to_apply: Visit www.wbhealth.gov.in for the online application.
Pay the fee after registration using application ID and Date of Birth by net banking, UPI or credit/debit card by 23-11-2026.
Re-login after successful payment and make final submission by 26-11-2026.
Upload proper and full signature and photograph; accept the pop-up during the process.
Download the online registration form from https://hr.wbhealth.gov.in and keep it for document verification.
important_instructions: No need to send hard copy of the online registration form by post Keep the Online Registration Number; employer is not liable to give it later Incomplete forms or forms differing from original testimonials will be cancelled Do not deposit the fee more than one time Updates will be posted on www.wbhealth.gov.in and www.birbhum.nic.in Queries: [email protected], or office visit Monday to Friday, 1.00 P.M. to 3.00 P.M.

rows.district_health_family_welfare_samiti_ra: Bachelor degree in Physiotherapy with at least 2 years of working experience in a hospital; Master degree in Physiotherapy desirable

content_sections.heading: DHFWS Rampurhat Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. 04/2026-2027 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download DHFWS Rampurhat notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Bachelor degree in Physiotherapy with at least 2 years of working experience in a hospital Experience: At least 2 years of working experience in a hospital Age limit: 21 to 40 years (as on 1 January 2026) Age relaxation: Reserved candidates As per govt. norms Other conditions: Desirable: Master degree in Physiotherapy

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for DHFWS Rampurhat Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates found ineligible at any stage will not be called for subsequent stages of the selection process

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Contractual post under NPHCE of National Health Mission Panel valid for up to 1 (one) year from the date of publishing of the panel

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: Payment mode: Online only through net banking / UPI payment or credit/debit card, using application ID and Date of Birth after registration. Last date to pay the fee: 23 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: How Will DHFWS Rampurhat Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Marks for academic qualification Marks for experience Interview of shortlisted candidates Class X: 10 marks, proportionate (% of marks x 10/100, excluding additional subjects) Bachelor degree in Physiotherapy: 10 marks, proportionate marking Experience: up to 10 marks (Govt.) or 5 marks (Pvt.) for 5 years and more Interview: 5 marks; total 50 marks

content_sections.heading: DHFWS Rampurhat Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: Marks in the score-sheet are rounded off up to 2 decimal points

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Printed online registration form, needed for original testimonials verification Experience Certificate on official letterhead with name, post, place of posting, project, joining and leaving dates, signed and dated Caste / Disability / EWS Certificate issued by competent authorities of West Bengal on or before the last date of online application

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for DHFWS Rampurhat Recruitment 2026 Online
content_sections.text: Visit www.wbhealth.gov.in for the online application. Register online between 13-11-2026 and 23-11-2026. Pay the fee after registration using application ID and Date of Birth by net banking, UPI or credit/debit card by 23-11-2026. Re-login after successful payment and make final submission by 26-11-2026. Upload proper and full signature and photograph; accept the pop-up during the process. Download the online registration form from https://hr.wbhealth.gov.in and keep it for document verification.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: No need to send hard copy of the online registration form by post Keep the Online Registration Number; employer is not liable to give it later Incomplete forms or forms differing from original testimonials will be cancelled Do not deposit the fee more than one time Updates will be posted on www.wbhealth.gov.in and www.birbhum.nic.in Queries: [email protected] , or office visit Monday to Friday, 1.00 P.M. to 3.00 P.M.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for DHFWS Rampurhat Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 26 November 2026. Applications opened on 13 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in DHFWS Rampurhat Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 6 vacancies for Multi Rehabilitation Worker.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for DHFWS Rampurhat Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 26 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: General Caste: Rs.100. Reserved Category: Rs.50.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is 21 to 40 years (as on 1 January 2026). Relaxation: Reserved candidates As per govt. norms.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs. 18,000 monthly consolidated remuneration.

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Bachelor degree in Physiotherapy with at least 2 years of working experience in a hospital; Master degree in Physiotherapy desirable.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Must be a permanent resident of West Bengal. Must be able to read, write and speak in Bengali. All qualifications must be from a recognized institute/University. All essential qualifications must be obtained on or before the publication of the advertisement.

faq.question: Q9. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates found ineligible at any stage will not be called for subsequent stages of the selection process.

faq.question: Q10. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Marks for academic qualification. Marks for experience. Interview of shortlisted candidates. Class X: 10 marks, proportionate (% of marks x 10/100, excluding additional subjects).
